stem: Which sentence best shows that the rat overestimates his abilities?

options.label: A
options.text: One day a little brown beetle was crawling along a wall when a big grey rat ran out of a hole in the wall and looked down scornfully at the little beetle. (paragraph 2)

options.label: B
options.text: The big grey rat ran to the end of the wall, wheeled around, and came back to the place where the little beetle was slowly crawling along at only a tiny distance from where the rat had left her. (paragraph 3)

options.label: C
options.text: "Why, you talk just as if you thought you had a chance to win the race," he said, when he could speak. (paragraph 9)

options.label: D
options.text: Then he started to run more slowly but every time his heart beat it said, "Hurry up! Hurry up!" (paragraph 11)
